name: robots/inria-paris-robotics-lab__unitree_simulation
title: Unitree Go2 ROS 2 pybullet simulation
intro: Unitree Go2 ROS 2 pybullet simulation, adapted from inria-paris-robotics-lab/unitree_simulation. It reads `pose`, `twist`, `motor_state` and `read_lowstate`; runs `publish_lowcmd`, `reset_simulation` and `unlock_base`. `publish_lowcmd`: publish one unitree_go/LowCmd on /lowcmd; the node applies it on its next timer tick. Transmission only: no execution, arrival or stop acknowledgement. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
